To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
meditation reduces pain unpleasantness ratings by modulating brain activity in the orbitofrontal and anterior cingulate cortices.
Mindfulness meditation training reduced pain unpleasantness and pain intensity ratings.
mindfulness meditation training reduces pain unpleasantness by engaging the orbitofrontal and anterior insula and reduces pain intensity by engaging the thalamus and anterior cingulate.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the neural mechanisms by how mindfulness meditation influences pain processing.
the mechanisms of mindfulness meditation.
how the brain processes pain and how meditation influences this process.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the brain areas associated with the reduction in pain are the following: anterior cingulate, anterior insula, orbitofrontal, thalamic, and contralateral primary sensory cortex.
mindfulness meditation training can reduce pain intensity and unpleasantness in healthy participants by engaging brain areas involved in cognitive and affective regulation of nociception.

the results of the current study suggest that mindfulness meditation training can reduce the unpleasantness of pain, in part, by altering the activity of brain regions involved in the cognitive appraisal of pain.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
meditation engages multiple mechanisms that alter the subjective experience of pain.
the subjective experience of pain is not an inevitable consequence of nociceptive input, but rather, it is constructed by interactions between sensory, cognitive and affective processes.
the subjective experience of pain is not an objective phenomenon, but rather a subjective phenomenon that can be influenced through the use of meditation.
The main takeaway from our work is that
meditation can reduce pain.
mindfulness meditation can alter pain perception.
mindfulness meditation training can reduce the unpleasant and intensity ratings of pain.
